title: Q1 2026 - Manager prep & self-review notes
content:
Purpose: quick manager prep + raw self-review notes ahead of calibration and my 1:1. Drafty, will clean for formal review.

Quick context: promoted to Senior People Ops in Aug 2025; supporting platform eng and serving-runtime hires, two high-priority exec org changes rolled out in Nov-Dec (benefits + comp baseline). Focused on hiring operations, new ATS workflow, and manager enablement for ramp.

Wins (last 6 months):
- Launched ATS automation flows (Greenhouse -> internal onboarding checklist). Cut manual intake time from ~6 hours to ~1.5 hours for each new hire; measured on 40 hires Nov-Jan.
- Designed manager onboarding pack (templates + 30/60/90) and ran pilot with Platform Eng managers (4 managers): positive qualitative feedback, 3/4 said it reduced onboarding questions in week 1.
- Led comp benchmarking project for engineering IC/manager bands; final recommendations shared with Comp team (doc link above). Helped reduce offer negotiation time by ~22% on average.
- Incident response for payroll compliance issue (Dec): coordinated with finance/legal, documented runbook. No downstream customer impact, internal postmortem done.

Metrics / signals:
- Time-to-productive-new-hire (survey) baseline = 9.1 weeks -> pilot cohort 7.6 weeks (small sample n=12).
- Offer acceptance rate for targeted eng roles improved from 74% -> 81% during pilot period.
- Manager satisfaction (pilot feedback NPS-ish) = +28 (small sample).

Top goals for next 6 months (what I want to be recognized for):
- Fully roll out ATS automation company-wide and reduce manual onboarding steps by 60% by EOY Q3.
- Build manager enablement playbook (templates, recorded trainings, rubric) and get adoption from 70% of new managers.
- Create a lightweight new-hire quality metric (onboarding survey + 30/60 signals) and baseline across 3 orgs.

Stretch goals (reach):
- Push for a self-serve onboarding portal (MVP) with checklist + links by Q4 (requires eng support).
- Draft a manager certification micro-credential (internal badge) in partnership with L&D.

Development areas / feedback I want:
- Strategic visibility: I want help getting my work framed in org-level outcomes (not just operational wins). How to present impact to senior leadership succinctly?
- Stakeholder management: feel like I can escalate earlier but sometimes wait to gather more data; want to be more comfortable making a call with incomplete info.
- Tech fluency: would like a 1:1 with an SRE/infra PM to better understand deployment timelines so I can align hiring projections.

Blockers / dependencies:
- Engineering bandwidth for portal -> needs a prioritization slot in Q3 roadmap.
- Data access: need HRIS export privileges (requested to IT on 2026-02-10, ticket HR-504) to build the onboarding metric reliably.
- Comp sign-off: final comp band approval dependent on Finance leadership review (meeting on 2026-02-25).

Questions for you (manager):
1) Prioritization: Given Platform Eng and Serving Runtime hiring needs, should ATS automation rollout prioritize those orgs first or do a cross-org parallel rollout? Pros/cons?
2) Visibility: would it help if I created a 1-pager metric dashboard for exec weekly sync? I can produce a one-slide summary if you want.
3) Coaching: can we book a 30-min calibration on "presenting ops impact" — I'd like feedback on a 5-min exec-ready narrative.

Notes for calibration / performance themes I expect to surface:
- Strength in execution and cross-functional coordination.
- Reliable operator who surfaces risks early and drives remediation.
- Opportunity to be more proactive in shaping strategic hiring forecasts and framing ops impact as revenue/eng-effort-savings.

Risks to flag:
- If engineering bandwidth remains constrained, onboarding portal will slip — impacts scaling plan for Dedicated hiring.
- Data lag: without HRIS exports, my onboarding quality metric will be brittle; could mislead leaders if partial data used.

1:1 agenda (my proposed):
- 5 min: quick updates & wins
- 10 min: blockers + dependency decisions (engineering prioritization, HRIS access)
- 10 min: feedback on calibrating my narrative for execs (run through 2 slides)
- 5 min: career development / stretch goal alignment

Action items / TODOs after our 1:1:
- [ ] Share one-slide exec summary draft by Tue 2026-02-24.
- [ ] Follow up with IT on HRIS export ticket (HR-504) and escalate if no update by 2026-02-23.
- [ ] Draft rollout plan for ATS automation (phased vs big-bang) and share for review.

Random notes / snippets to capture:
- "Manager enablement" doc needs a short video walkthrough — quick Loom could help adoption.
- Consider adding "expected handoff checklist" between recruiter -> hiring manager -> IT on day -1.
- Feedback from Platform Eng pilot: include a short FAQ about access requests (most managers asked same 5 questions).

End — will tidy and move to formal self-review doc if you want.
